entity_id_collision.title: Labeled Features entity id collision
entity_id_collision.description: Expected to create `{expected}` but the entity was registered as `{actual}` because another entity (likely the legacy template sensor) already owns that id. Downstream automations and scripts read `{expected}` and will not see this integration's data. Remove the legacy template sensor from configuration.yaml, delete `{actual}` from the entity registry, and reload the integration.
